mn95:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena opasādaṃ nāma kosalānaṃ brāhmaṇagāmo tadavasari.
mn95:1.3: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā opasāde viharati uttarena opasādaṃ devavane sālavane.
mn95:2.1: tena kho pana samayena caṅkī brāhmaṇo opasādaṃ ajjhāvasati sattussadaṃ satiṇakaṭṭhodakaṃ sadhaññaṃ rājabhoggaṃ raññā pasenadinā kosalena dinnaṃ rājadāyaṃ brahmadeyyaṃ.
mn95:3.2: ‘samaṇo khalu bho gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ opasādaṃ anuppatto opasāde viharati uttarena opasādaṃ devavane sālavane.
mn95:3.3: taṃ kho pana bhagavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato:
mn95:3.4: ‘itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā’ti.
mn95:3.5: so imaṃ lokaṃ sadevakaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiṃ pajaṃ sadevamanussaṃ sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā pavedeti.
mn95:3.6: so dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti.
mn95:3.7: sādhu kho pana tathārūpānaṃ arahataṃ dassanaṃ hotī’ti.
mn95:4.1: atha kho opasādakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā opasādā nikkhamitvā saṅghāsaṅghī gaṇībhūtā uttarena mukhā gacchanti yena devavanaṃ sālavanaṃ.
mn95:5.1: tena kho pana samayena caṅkī brāhmaṇo upari pāsāde divāseyyaṃ upagato hoti.
mn95:5.2: addasā kho caṅkī brāhmaṇo opasādake brāhmaṇagahapatike, opasādā nikkhamitvā saṅghāsaṅghī gaṇībhūte uttarena mukhe gacchante yena devavanaṃ sālavanaṃ, disvāna
mn95:5.4: kinnu kho bho khatte, opasādakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā opasādā nikkhamitvā saṅghāsaṅghī gaṇībhūtā uttarena mukhā gacchanti yena devavanaṃ sālavananti.
mn95:6.1: atthi bho caṅkī, samaṇo bho gotamo sakyaputto sakyakulā pabbajito kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ opasādaṃ anuppatto opasāde viharati uttarena opasādaṃ devavane sālavane.
mn95:6.2: taṃ kho pana bhagavantaṃ gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato:
mn95:6.3: itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā’ti.
mn95:6.5: tena hi bho khatte, yena opasādakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā tenupasaṅkama, upasaṅkamitvā opasādake brāhmaṇagahapatike evaṃ vadehi:
mn95:6.7: āgamentu kira bhavanto, caṅkīpi brāhmaṇo samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamissatī’ti.
mn95:6.8: evaṃ bhoti kho so khatto caṅkissa brāhmaṇassa paṭissutvā yena opasādakā brāhmaṇagahapatikā tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā opasādake brāhmaṇagahapatike etadavoca:
mn95:6.10: āgamentu kira bhavanto, caṅkīpi brāhmaṇo samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamissatī’ti.
mn95:7.1: tena kho pana samayena nānāverajjakānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ pañcamattāni brāhmaṇasatāni opasāde paṭivasanti kenacideva karaṇīyena.
mn95:7.3: caṅkī kira brāhmaṇo samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamissatī’ti.
mn95:7.4: atha kho te brāhmaṇā yena caṅkī brāhmaṇo tenupasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā caṅkiṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etadavocuṃ:
mn95:7.5: saccaṃ kira bhavaṃ caṅkī samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamissatī’ti.
mn95:8.1: mā bhavaṃ caṅkī samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkami.
mn95:8.2: na arahati bhavaṃ caṅkī samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ,
mn95:8.3: samaṇotveva gotamo arahati bhavantaṃ caṅkiṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.
mn95:8.4: bhavaṃ hi caṅkī ubhato sujāto mātito ca pitito ca, saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jātivādena,
mn95:8.5: yampi bhavaṃ caṅkī ubhato sujāto mātito ca pitito ca, saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jātivādena. imināpaṅgena na arahati bhavaṃ caṅkī samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ,
mn95:8.6: samaṇo tveva gotamo arahati bhavantaṃ caṅkiṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.
mn95:8.7: bhavaṃ hi caṅkī aḍḍho mahaddhano mahābhogo …pe…
mn95:8.8: bhavaṃ hi caṅkī tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ, padako veyyākaraṇo, lokāyatamahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo …pe…
mn95:8.9: bhavaṃ hi caṅkī abhirūpo dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgato brahmavaṇṇī brahmavaccasī akkhuddāvakāso dassanāya …pe…
mn95:8.10: bhavaṃ hi caṅkī sīlavā vuddhasīlī vuddhasīlena samannāgato …pe…
mn95:8.11: bhavaṃ hi caṅkī kalyāṇavāco kalyāṇavākkaraṇo poriyā vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya anelagalāya atthassa viññāpaniyā …pe…
mn95:8.12: bhavaṃ hi caṅkī bahunnaṃ ācariyapācariyo tīṇi māṇavakasatāni mante vāceti …pe…
mn95:8.13: bhavaṃ hi caṅkī rañño pasenadissa kosalassa sakkato garukato mānito pūjito apacito …pe…
mn95:8.14: bhavaṃ hi caṅkī brāhmaṇassa pokkharasātissa sakkato garukato mānito pūjito apacito …pe…
mn95:8.15: bhavaṃ hi caṅkī opasādaṃ ajjhāvasati sattussadaṃ satiṇakaṭṭhodakaṃ sadhaññaṃ rājabhoggaṃ raññā pasenadinā kosalena dinnaṃ rājadāyaṃ brahmadeyyaṃ.
mn95:8.16: yampi bhavaṃ caṅkī opasādaṃ ajjhāvasati sattussadaṃ satiṇakaṭṭhodakaṃ sadhaññaṃ rājabhoggaṃ raññā pasenadinā kosalena dinnaṃ rājadāyaṃ brahmadeyyaṃ imināpaṅgena na arahati bhavaṃ caṅkī samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.
mn95:8.17: samaṇotveva gotamo arahati bhavantaṃ caṅkiṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamitu’nti.
mn95:9.1: evaṃ vutte caṅkī brāhmaṇo te brāhmaṇe etadavoca:
mn95:9.2: tena hi bho, mamapi suṇātha yathā mayameva arahāma taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.
mn95:9.3: na tveva arahati so bhavaṃ gotamo amhākaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.
mn95:9.4: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo ubhato sujāto mātito ca pitito ca, saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jātivādena.
mn95:9.5: yampi bho samaṇo gotamo ubhato sujāto mātito ca pitito ca, saṃsuddhagahaṇiko yāva sattamā pitāmahayugā akkhitto anupakkuṭṭho jātivādena, imināpaṅgena na arahati so bhavaṃ gotamo amhākaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ,
mn95:9.6: atha kho mayameva arahāma taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.
mn95:9.7: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo pahūtaṃ hiraññasuvaṇṇaṃ ohāya pabbajito bhūmigatañca vehāsaṭṭhañca …pe…
mn95:9.8: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo daharo samāno susukālakeso bhadrena yobbanena samannāgato paṭhamena vayasā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito …pe…
mn95:9.9: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo akāmakānaṃ mātāpitunnaṃ assumukhānaṃ rudantānaṃ kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito …pe…
mn95:9.10: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo abhirūpo dassanīyo pāsādiko paramāya vaṇṇapokkharatāya samannāgato brahmavaṇṇī brahmavaccasī akkhuddāvakāso dassanāya …pe…
mn95:9.11: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo sīlavā ariyasīlī kusalasīlī kusalasīlena samannāgato …pe…
mn95:9.12: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo kalyāṇavāco kalyāṇavākkaraṇo poriyā vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya anelagalāya atthassa viññāpaniyā …pe…
mn95:9.13: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo bahunnaṃ ācariyapācariyo …pe…
mn95:9.14: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo khīṇakāmarāgo vigatacāpallo …pe…
mn95:9.15: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo kammavādī kiriyavādī apāpapurekkhāro brahmaññāya pajāya …pe…
mn95:9.16: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo uccākulā pabbajito asambhinnā khattiyakulā …pe…
mn95:9.17: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo aḍḍhakulā pabbajito mahaddhanā mahābhogā …pe…
mn95:9.18: samaṇaṃ khalu bho gotamaṃ tiroraṭṭhā tirojanapadā sampucchituṃ āgacchanti …pe…
mn95:9.19: samaṇaṃ khalu bho gotamaṃ anekāni devatāsahassāni pāṇehi saraṇaṃ gatāni …pe…
mn95:9.20: samaṇaṃ khalu bho gotamaṃ evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato:
mn95:9.21: itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā’ti …pe…
mn95:9.22: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo dvattiṃsamahāpurisalakkhaṇehi samannāgato …pe…
mn95:9.23: samaṇaṃ khalu bho gotamaṃ rājā māgadho seniyo bimbisāro saputtadāro pāṇehi saraṇaṃ gato …pe…
mn95:9.24: samaṇaṃ khalu bho gotamaṃ rājā pasenadi kosalo saputtadāro pāṇehi saraṇaṃ gato …pe…
mn95:9.25: samaṇaṃ khalu bho gotamaṃ brāhmaṇo pokkharasāti saputtadāro pāṇehi saraṇaṃ gato …pe…
mn95:9.26: samaṇo khalu bho gotamo opasādaṃ anuppatto opasāde viharati uttarena opasādaṃ devavane sālavane.
mn95:9.27: ye pana kho keci samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā amhākaṃ gāmakkhettaṃ āgacchanti. atithī no te honti.
mn95:9.28: atithī kho panamhehi sakkātabbā garukātabbā mānetabbā pūjetabbā.
mn95:9.29: yampi bho samaṇo gotamo opasādaṃ anuppatto opasāde viharati uttarena opasādaṃ devavane sālavane. atithi asmākaṃ samaṇo gotamo.
mn95:9.30: atithi kho panamhehi sakkātabbo garukātabbo mānetabbo pūjetabbo.
mn95:9.31: imināpaṅgena na arahati so bhavaṃ gotamo amhākaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.
mn95:9.32: atha kho mayameva arahāma taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.
mn95:9.33: ettakaṃ kho ahaṃ bho tassa bhoto gotamassa vaṇṇaṃ pariyāpuṇāmi. no ca so bhavaṃ gotamo ettakavaṇṇo,
mn95:9.35: ekamekenapi bho, aṅgena samannāgato na arahati so bhavaṃ gotamo amhākaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.
mn95:9.36: atha kho mayameva arahāma taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamituṃ.
mn95:9.37: tena hi bho sabbeva mayaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamissāmā’ti.
mn95:10.1: atha kho caṅkī brāhmaṇo mahatā brāhmaṇagaṇena saddhiṃ yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.
mn95:10.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
mn95:11.1: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā vuddhehi vuddhehi brāhmaṇehi saddhiṃ kiñci kiñci kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā nisinno hoti.
mn95:11.2: tena kho pana samayena kāpaṭiko nāma māṇavo daharo vuttasiro soḷasavassuddesiko jātiyā, tiṇṇaṃ vedānaṃ pāragū sanighaṇḍukeṭubhānaṃ sākkharappabhedānaṃ itihāsapañcamānaṃ padako veyyākaraṇo lokāyatamahāpurisalakkhaṇesu anavayo, tassaṃ parisāyaṃ nisinno hoti.
mn95:11.3: so vuddhānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ bhagavatā saddhiṃ mantayamānānaṃ antarantarā kathaṃ opāteti.
mn95:11.4: atha kho bhagavā kāpaṭikaṃ māṇavaṃ apasādesi:
mn95:11.5: māyasmā bhāradvājo vuddhānaṃ vuddhānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ mantayamānānaṃ antarantarā kathaṃ opātetu,
mn95:11.7: evaṃ vutte caṅkī brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn95:11.8: mā bhavaṃ gotamo kāpaṭikaṃ māṇavaṃ apasādesi,
mn95:11.9: kulaputto ca kāpaṭiko māṇavo bahussuto ca kāpaṭiko māṇavo kalyāṇavākkaraṇo ca kāpaṭiko māṇavo paṇḍito ca kāpaṭiko māṇavo, pahoti ca kāpaṭiko māṇavo bhotā gotamena saddhiṃ asmiṃ vacane patimantetu’nti.
mn95:12.2: ‘addhā kho kāpaṭikassa māṇavassa tevijjake pāvacane kataṃ bhavissati.
mn95:12.5: ‘yadā me samaṇo gotamo cakkhunā cakkhuṃ upasaṃharissati, athāhaṃ samaṇaṃ gotamaṃ pañhaṃ pucchissāmī’ti.
mn95:12.6: atha kho bhagavā kāpaṭikassa māṇavassa cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya yena kāpaṭiko māṇavo tena cakkhūni upasaṃhāsi.
mn95:12.10: atha kho kāpaṭiko māṇavo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
mn95:12.11: ‘yamidaṃ bho gotama, brāhmaṇānaṃ porāṇānaṃ mantapadaṃ itihitiha paramparāya piṭakasampadāya, tattha ca brāhmaṇā ekaṃsena niṭṭhaṃ gacchanti.
mn95:13.1: kiṃ pana bhāradvāja, atthi koci brāhmaṇānaṃ ekabrāhmaṇopi yo evamāha:
mn95:13.5: kiṃ pana bhāradvāja, atthi koci brāhmaṇānaṃ ekācariyopi ekācariyapācariyopi yāva sattamā ācariyamahayugāpi, yo evamāha:
mn95:13.9: kiṃ pana bhāradvāja, yepi te brāhmaṇānaṃ pubbakā isayo mantānaṃ kattāro mantānaṃ pavattāro, yesamidaṃ etarahi brāhmaṇā porāṇaṃ mantapadaṃ gītaṃ pavuttaṃ samihitaṃ tadanugāyanti tadanubhāsanti, bhāsitamanubhāsanti, vācitamanuvācenti. seyyathīdaṃ: ‘aṭṭako vāmako vāmadevo vessāmitto yamataggi aṅgīraso bhāradvājo vāseṭṭho kassapo bhagu.
mn95:13.14: iti kira bhāradvāja, natthi koci brāhmaṇānaṃ ekabrāhmaṇopi yo evamāha:
mn95:13.17: natthi koci brāhmaṇānaṃ ekācariyopi ekācariyapācariyopi yāva sattamā ācariyamahayugā, yo evamāha:
mn95:13.20: yepi te brāhmaṇānaṃ pubbakā isayo mantānaṃ kattāro mantānaṃ pavattāro yesamidaṃ etarahi brāhmaṇā porāṇaṃ mantapadaṃ gītaṃ pavuttaṃ samihitaṃ tadanugāyanti, tadanubhāsanti, bhāsitamanubhāsanti, vācitamanuvācenti. seyyathidaṃ: ‘aṭṭako vāmako vāmadevo vessāmitto yamataggi aṅgīraso bhāradvājo vāseṭṭho kassapo bhagu’ tepi na evamāhaṃsu:
mn95:13.23: ‘seyyathāpi bhāradvāja, andhaveṇi paramparāsaṃsattā purimopi na passati, majjhimopi na passati, pacchimopi na passati.
mn95:13.24: evameva kho bhāradvāja, andhaveṇūpamaṃ maññe brāhmaṇānaṃ bhāsitaṃ sampajjati. purimopi na passati, majjhimopi na passati, pacchimopi na passati.
mn95:13.26: na nu evaṃ sante brāhmaṇānaṃ amūlikā saddhā sampajjatī’ti.
mn95:14.1: na khottha bho gotama, brāhmaṇā saddhāyeva payirupāsanti, anussavāpettha brāhmaṇā payirupāsantī’ti.
mn95:14.2: pubbeva kho tvaṃ bhāradvāja, saddhaṃ agamāsi, anussavaṃ idāni vadesi.
mn95:14.3: pañca kho ime, bhāradvāja, dhammā diṭṭhevadhamme dvidhā vipākā.
mn95:14.6: ime kho bhāradvāja, pañca dhammā diṭṭhevadhamme dvidhā vipākā.
mn95:14.7: api ca bhāradvāja, susaddahitaṃ yeva hoti, tañca hoti rittaṃ tucchaṃ musā,
mn95:14.8: no cepi susaddahitaṃ hoti, bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ anaññathā.
mn95:14.9: api ca bhāradvāja, surucitaṃ yeva hoti. …pe…
mn95:14.12: sunijjhāyitaṃ yeva hoti. tañca hoti rittaṃ tucchaṃ musā,
mn95:14.13: no cepi sunijjhāyitaṃ hoti, bhūtaṃ tacchaṃ anaññathā.
mn95:14.14: saccamanurakkhatā bhāradvāja, viññunā purisena nālamettha ekaṃsena niṭṭhaṃ gantuṃ
mn95:15.1: kittāvatā pana bho gotama, saccānurakkhanā hoti, kittāvatā saccamanurakkhati?
mn95:15.5: iti vadaṃ saccamanurakkhati, na tveva tāva ekaṃsena niṭṭhaṃ gacchati:
mn95:15.6: ‘idameva saccaṃ moghamañña’nti. ettāvatā kho bhāradvāja saccānurakkhanā hoti. ettāvatā saccamanurakkhati. ettāvatā ca mayaṃ saccānurakkhanaṃ paññāpema. na tveva tāva saccānubodho hoti.
mn95:15.12: iti vadaṃ saccamanurakkhati na tveva tāva ekaṃsena niṭṭhaṃ gacchati:
mn95:15.14: ettāvatā kho bhāradvāja, saccānurakkhanā hoti, ettāvatā saccamanurakkhati, ettāvatā ca mayaṃ saccānurakkhanaṃ paññāpema.
mn95:16.1: ettāvatā bho gotama, saccānurakkhanā hoti, ettāvatā saccamanurakkhati, ettāvatā ca mayaṃ saccānurakkhanaṃ pekkhāma.
mn95:16.2: kittāvatā pana bho gotama, saccānubodho hoti, kittāvatā saccamanubujjhati?
mn95:17.1: idha bhāradvāja bhikkhu aññataraṃ gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā upanissāya viharati.
mn95:17.2: tamenaṃ gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā upasaṅkamitvā tīsu dhammesu samannesati:
mn95:17.3: lobhanīyesu dhammesu dosanīyesu dhammesu mohanīyesu dhammesu.
mn95:17.4: atthi nu kho imassa āyasmato tathārūpā lobhanīyā dhammā yathārūpehi lobhanīyehi dhammehi pariyādinnacitto ajānaṃ vā vadeyya
mn95:17.6: passāmīti, paraṃ vā tathattāya samādapeyya yaṃ paresaṃ assa dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyāti.
mn95:17.8: natthi kho imassāyasmato tathārūpā lobhanīyā dhammā yathārūpehi lobhanīyehi dhammehi pariyādinnacitto ajānaṃ vā vadeyya
mn95:17.10: passāmīti, paraṃ vā tathattāya samādapeyya, yaṃ paresaṃ assa dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyāti,
mn95:17.11: tathā kho panimassāyasmato kāyasamācāro, tathā vacīsamācāro, yathā taṃ aluddhassa:
mn95:17.12: yaṃ kho pana ayamāyasmā dhammaṃ deseti, gambhīro so dhammo duddaso duranubodho santo paṇīto atakkāvacaro nipuṇo paṇḍitavedanīyo,
mn95:18.1: yato naṃ samannesamāno visuddhaṃ lobhanīyehi dhammehi samanupassati. tato naṃ uttariṃ samannesati dosanīyesu dhammesu:
mn95:18.2: atthi nu kho imassa āyasmato tathārūpā dosanīyā dhammā yathārūpehi dosanīyehi dhammehi pariyādinnacitto ajānaṃ vā vadeyya
mn95:18.4: passāmīti, paraṃ vā tathattāya samādapeyya, yaṃ paresaṃ assa dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyāti.
mn95:18.6: natthi kho imassāyasmato tathārūpā dosanīyā dhammā, yathārūpehi dosanīyehi dhammehi pariyādinnacitto ajānaṃ vā vadeyya
mn95:18.8: passāmīti, paraṃ vā tathattāya samādapeyya yaṃ paresaṃ assa dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyā’ti.
mn95:18.9: tathā kho panimassāyasmato kāyasamācāro, tathā vacīsamācāro, yathā taṃ aduṭṭhassa.
mn95:18.10: yaṃ kho pana ayamāyasmā dhammaṃ deseti. gambhīro so dhammo duddaso duranubodho santo paṇīto atakkāvacaro nipuṇo paṇḍitavedanīyo,
mn95:19.1: yato naṃ samannesamāno visuddhaṃ dosanīyehi dhammehi samanupassati. tato naṃ uttariṃ samannesati mohanīyesu dhammesu:
mn95:19.2: atthi nu kho imassa āyasmato tathārūpā mohanīyā dhammā, yathā rūpehi mohanīyehi dhammehi pariyādinnacitto ajānaṃ vā vadeyya
mn95:19.4: passāmīti, paraṃ vā tathattāya samādapeyya, yaṃ paresaṃ assa dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāyāti.
mn95:19.6: natthi kho imassāyasmato tathārūpā mohanīyā dhammā yathārūpehi mohanīyehi dhammehi pariyādinnacitto ajānaṃ vā vadeyya
mn95:19.8: passāmīti. paraṃ vā tathattāya samādapeyya yaṃ paresaṃ assa dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya.
mn95:19.9: tathā kho panimassāyasmato kāyasamācāro, tathā vacīsamācāro, yathā taṃ amūḷhassa.
mn95:19.10: yaṃ kho pana ayamāyasmā dhammaṃ deseti. gambhīro so dhammo duddaso duranubodho santo paṇīto atakkāvacaro nipuṇo paṇḍitavedanīyo,
mn95:20.1: yato naṃ samannesamāno visuddhaṃ mohanīyehi dhammehi samanupassati.
mn95:20.2: atha tasmiṃ saddhaṃ niveseti. saddhājāto upasaṅkamati. upasaṅkamanto payirupāsati. payirupāsanto sotaṃ odahati. ohitasoto dhammaṃ suṇāti. sutvā dhammaṃ dhāreti. dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthaṃ upaparikkhati. atthaṃ upaparikkhato dhammā nijjhānaṃ khamanti. dhammanijjhānakkhantiyā sati chando jāyati. chandajāto ussahati. ussahitvā tulayati. tulayitvā pahadati. pahitatto samāno kāyena ceva paramasaccaṃ sacchikaroti. paññāya ca naṃ ativijjha passati.
mn95:20.3: ettāvatā kho bhāradvāja, saccānubodho hoti. ettāvatā saccamanubujjhati. ettāvatā ca mayaṃ saccānubodhaṃ paññāpema.
mn95:21.1: ettāvatā bho gotama, saccānubodho hoti, ettāvatā saccamanubujjhati, ettāvatā ca mayaṃ saccānubodhaṃ pekkhāma.
mn95:21.2: kittāvatā pana bho gotama, saccānupatti hoti? kittāvatā saccamanupāpuṇāti?
mn95:21.4: tesaṃyeva kho bhāradvāja, dhammānaṃ āsevanā bhāvanā bahulīkammā saccānupatti hoti,
mn95:21.5: ettāvatā kho bhāradvāja, saccānupatti hoti, ettāvatā saccamanupāpuṇāti, ettāvatā ca mayaṃ saccānupattiṃ paññāpemāti.
mn95:22.1: ettāvatā bho gotama, saccānupatti hoti, ettāvatā saccamanupāpuṇāti, ettāvatā ca mayaṃ saccānupattiṃ pekkhāma.
mn95:22.2: saccānupattiyā pana bho gotama, katamo dhammo bahukāro?
mn95:22.3: saccānupattiyā bahukāraṃ dhammaṃ mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ pucchāmāti.
mn95:22.5: no cetaṃ padaheyya, nayidaṃ saccaṃ anupāpuṇeyya.
mn95:22.6: yasmā ca kho padahati, tasmā saccaṃ anupāpuṇāti.
mn95:23.1: padhānassa pana bho gotama, katamo dhammo bahukāro?
mn95:23.2: padhānassa bahukāraṃ dhammaṃ mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ pucchāmāti.
mn95:23.5: yasmā ca kho tuleti, tasmā padahati.
mn95:24.1: tulanāya pana bho gotama, katamo dhammo bahukāro?
mn95:24.2: tulanāya bahukāraṃ dhammaṃ mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ pucchāmāti.
mn95:24.5: yasmā ca kho ussahati, tasmā tuleti.
mn95:25.1: ussāhassa pana bho gotama, katamo dhammo bahukāro?
mn95:25.2: ussāhassa bahukāraṃ dhammaṃ mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ pucchāmāti.
mn95:25.4: no cetaṃ chando jāyetha, nayidaṃ ussaheyya.
mn95:25.5: yasmā ca kho chando jāyati, tasmā ussahati.
mn95:26.1: chandassa pana bho gotama, katamo dhammo bahukāro?
mn95:26.2: chandassa bahukāraṃ dhammaṃ mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ pucchāmāti.
mn95:26.4: no cetaṃ dhammanijjhānaṃ khameyyuṃ, nayidaṃ chando jāyetha.
mn95:26.5: yasmā ca kho dhammanijjhānaṃ khamanti, tasmā chando jāyati.
mn95:27.1: dhammanijjhānakkhantiyā pana bho gotama, katamo dhammo bahukāro?
mn95:27.2: dhammanijjhānakkhantiyā bahukāraṃ dhammaṃ mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ pucchāmāti.
mn95:27.4: no cetaṃ atthaṃ upaparikkheyya, nayidaṃ dhammanijjhānaṃ khameyyuṃ.
mn95:27.5: yasmā ca kho atthaṃ upaparikkhati, tasmā dhammanijjhānaṃ khamanti.
mn95:28.1: atthūpaparikkhāya pana bho gotama, katamo dhammo bahukāro?
mn95:28.2: atthūpaparikkhāya bahukāraṃ dhammaṃ mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ pucchāmāti.
mn95:28.4: no cetaṃ dhammaṃ dhāreyya, nayidaṃ atthaṃ upaparikkheyya.
mn95:28.5: yasmā ca kho dhammaṃ dhāreti, tasmā atthaṃ upaparikkhati.
mn95:29.1: dhammadhāraṇāya pana bho gotama, katamo dhammo bahukāro?
mn95:29.2: dhammadhāraṇāya bahukāraṃ dhammaṃ mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ pucchāmāti.
mn95:29.4: no cetaṃ dhammaṃ suṇeyya, nayidaṃ dhammaṃ dhāreyya.
mn95:29.5: yasmā ca kho dhammaṃ suṇāti, tasmā dhammaṃ dhāreti.
mn95:30.1: dhammasavanassa pana bho gotama, katamo dhammo bahukāro?
mn95:30.2: dhammasavanassa bahukāraṃ dhammaṃ mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ pucchāmāti.
mn95:30.4: no cetaṃ sotaṃ odaheyya, na idaṃ dhammaṃ suṇeyya.
mn95:30.5: yasmā ca kho sotaṃ odahati, tasmā dhammaṃ suṇāti.
mn95:31.1: sotāvadhānassa pana bho gotama, katamo dhammo bahukāro?
mn95:31.2: sotāvadhānassa bahukāraṃ dhammaṃ mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ pucchāmāti.
mn95:31.4: no cetaṃ payirupāseyya, nayidaṃ sotaṃ odaheyya.
mn95:31.5: yasmā ca kho payirupāsati. tasmā sotaṃ odahati.
mn95:32.1: payirupāsanāya pana bho gotama, katamo dhammo bahukāro?
mn95:32.2: payirupāsanāya bahukāraṃ dhammaṃ mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ pucchāmāti.
mn95:32.5: yasmā ca kho upasaṅkamati, tasmā payirupāsati.
mn95:33.1: upasaṅkamanassa pana bho gotama, katamo dhammo bahukāro?
mn95:33.2: upasaṅkamanassa bahukāraṃ dhammaṃ mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ pucchāmāti.
mn95:33.4: no cetaṃ saddhā jāyetha, nayidaṃ upasaṅkameyya.
mn95:33.5: yasmā ca kho saddhā jāyati, tasmā upasaṅkamati.
mn95:34.1: saccānurakkhanaṃ mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ apucchimha. saccānurakkhanaṃ bhavaṃ gotamo byākāsi.
mn95:34.2: tañca panamhākaṃ ruccati ceva khamati ca, tena camhā attamanā.
mn95:34.3: saccānubodhaṃ mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ apucchimha. saccānubodhaṃ bhavaṃ go gotamo byākāsi.
mn95:34.4: tañca panamhākaṃ ruccati ceva khamati ca, tena camhā attamanā.
mn95:34.5: saccānupattiṃ mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ apucchimha. saccānupattiṃ bhavaṃ gotamo byākāsi.
mn95:34.6: tañca panamhākaṃ ruccati ceva khamati ca, tena camhā attamanā.
mn95:34.7: saccānupattiyā bahukāraṃ dhammaṃ mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ apucchimha. saccānupattiyā bahukāraṃ dhammaṃ bhavaṃ gotamo byākāsi.
mn95:34.8: tañca panamhākaṃ ruccati ceva khamati ca, tena camhā attamanā.
mn95:34.9: yaṃ yadeva ca pana mayaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ apucchimha, taṃ tadeva bhavaṃ gotamo byākāsi.
mn95:34.10: tañca panamhākaṃ ruccati ceva khamati ca, tena camhā attamanā.
mn95:34.11: mayaṃ hi bho gotama, pubbe evaṃ jānāma:
mn95:34.12: ke ca muṇḍakā samaṇakā ibbhā kaṇhā bandhupādāpaccā, ke ca dhammassa aññātāroti.
mn95:34.13: ajanesi vata me bhavaṃ gotamo samaṇesu samaṇapemaṃ, samaṇesu samaṇapasādaṃ, samaṇesu samaṇagāravaṃ.
mn95:35.1: abhikkantaṃ bho gotama, abhikkantaṃ bho gotama, …pe…
mn95:35.2: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatanti.
